coverage.evidence: The source comes first and the steps are split on pipes (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Templating/Dates/DateExpressionParser.cs:30-31). The output steps are format, relative, ordinal, until, since and diff (DateExpressionParser.cs:65-72). The offset units are y, mo, w, d, h, m and s (DateExpressionParser.cs:112-122). The step names are start, end, next, prev and tz (DateExpressionParser.cs:81-88), and lang is handled at DateExpressionParser.cs:48. The steps are applied in DateCalculator.cs:23-43. The registry lists time, time.utc, date and 14 date: forms, 17 in all (server/src/NomNomzBot.Application/Abstractions/Templating/TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:594-612).

The default output is yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm (DateOutputFormatter.cs:25,36). Relative output uses Humanize against now (DateOutputFormatter.cs:38-46) and ordinal output uses Day.Ordinalize (DateOutputFormatter.cs:47). The [o] token and the culture-aware pattern are at DateOutputFormatter.cs:79-88. {time} is HH:mm:ss, {time.utc} is HH:mm:ss plus ' UTC', and {date} is yyyy-MM-dd (Helpers/Legacy/LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:411-414). The page's worked examples (Thu 19:00, 10:30, 411 days, 59 days, 1 month, 28 days, 8 hours, 30 minutes) agree with these rules for Amsterdam on 2026-10-26 15:30 CET.

AllContexts is Command, EventResponse, Timer, Pipeline, Discord and Webhook (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:32-40). It applies to time, time.utc and date (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:594-596) and to every date: form through DateExpression() (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:199-200). The zone falls back to UTC when it is unset (DateExpressionContext.cs:70-71; LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:1691-1694). The Timezone and Language labels on Bot basics are in dashboard/src/views/dashboard/settings/i18n/en.json:92-99 and dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:895. The fallback culture is en (DateExpressionContext.cs:24-25).

now is read in the channel zone and utc in UTC (DateSourceReader.cs:37-40). A date alone becomes the start of the day in the zone (DateSourceReader.cs:42-44). The local date and time forms, with a T or a space, are at DateSourceReader.cs:25-31,46-51. A Z or +hh:mm offset is read as an instant and shown in the channel zone (DateSourceReader.cs:53,59-73). tz is WithZone (DateCalculator.cs:41) and accepts a Tzdb id (DateExpressionContext.cs:43). {stream.startedAt} is WentLiveAt in O format, or empty (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:450-453), and WentLiveAt is cleared when the stream goes offline (Stream/EventHandlers/ChannelOfflineHandler.cs:146). An empty source fails (DateExpressionParser.cs:32-33).

A step after the output step fails (DateExpressionParser.cs:42-43). Years, months, weeks and days use LocalDateTime arithmetic with AtLeniently, while hours, minutes and seconds add a Duration (DateCalculator.cs:45-58). start and end snap with weeks starting on Monday, and end is the next start minus 1 tick (DateCalculator.cs:65-86). next and prev use LocalDateTime.Next and Previous, so the time of day is kept (DateCalculator.cs:36-40). A weekday needs at least 3 letters of the English name (DateExpressionParser.cs:137-152).

No unit means Human (DateExpressionParser.cs:185-186). Singular and plural units, breakdown and human are at DateExpressionParser.cs:215-228, and diff takes a trailing unit at DateExpressionParser.cs:195-210. Earlier and later are ordered, so the count has no sign (DateSpanFormatter.cs:50-51). Human gives 2 parts (DateSpanFormatter.cs:56-63). Calendar units come from Period.Between on the local date and time, while hours, minutes and seconds come from elapsed real time (DateSpanFormatter.cs:75-102). Breakdown is years to seconds (DateSpanFormatter.cs:33-41,104-121). A failed expression returns match.Value (DateExpressionRenderer.cs:86-99), and a null result prints as written (Rendering/TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:19-21,117-118).

reader_answers.evidence: The format, tz and until forms in the answer agree with DateExpressionParser.cs:65-72,87 and DateCalculator.cs:41, and until:days with DateExpressionParser.cs:183-189,215-228.

The channel zone and language come from the channel settings (Platform/ChannelRegistry.cs:721-722) and fall back to UTC and en (DateExpressionContext.cs:24-25,70-74). The Bot basics Timezone and Language labels are in settings/i18n/en.json:92-99.

A failed render leaves the token as written (DateExpressionRenderer.cs:86-99; LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:184-187; TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:117-118). The failure causes listed match DateExpressionParser.cs:42-43,90-91,154-166 and DateExpressionRenderer.cs:56-61.

With no tz step the channel zone is used (DateSourceReader.cs:38). A tz step changes only this expression's zone through WithZone (DateCalculator.cs:41), and the steps after it run in the new zone because they read current.Zone (DateCalculator.cs:51-54,76,85).
